clues: Imani's boat is neither the Sea Pea nor the Wavelet.
Neither Gus nor Imani chose navy.
The navy paint is going on either the Lucky Gull or the Wavelet.
Imani picked either navy or sea green.
hints: Look at Imani's row of boats and at the navy column of owners. After clues 1 and 2, how many blanks does each have?
Clues 1 and 2 each leave one blank, so each gives a dot. Now read clue 3 beside clue 2: could the navy go on Imani's boat?
Imani's boat is the Lucky Gull, and navy is not hers, so clue 3 puts navy on the Wavelet. Navy is Basil's, so Basil brought in the Wavelet.

solution.key_idea: Navy is Basil's (clue 2) and cannot go on Imani's Lucky Gull, so clue 3 puts it on the Wavelet, Basil's boat.
steps: Clue 1 leaves Imani only the Lucky Gull. Clue 2 leaves only Basil for navy.
Clue 3 puts the navy on the Lucky Gull or the Wavelet. Imani did not choose navy, so it is not on her Lucky Gull.
So the navy goes on the Wavelet. Basil chose navy, so Basil brought in the Wavelet, and Gus the Sea Pea.
Clue 4 gives Imani navy or sea green. Navy is Basil's, so Imani chose sea green, and Gus chose cream.
So the Lucky Gull gets sea green, and the Sea Pea gets cream.
solution.epilogue: Gus painted the Sea Pea cream, Imani gave the Lucky Gull a coat of sea green, and Basil's Wavelet went navy. Felix called all three shipshape. Mostly shipshape.

tip: When two clues talk about the same thing, read them side by side.
